# Feature 1: Comment editing

PUT /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id with body {"comment":{"body":"..."}}. The comment author may edit their own comment within the edit window. A successful edit sets the edited marker.

## Rules used (source note in brackets; values not copied here)
- Edit permission and time window: policy-edit-window.md
- Owner field authorId: code-comment-ownership.md
- Comment fields: code-comment-model.md
- Edited marker and its migration rule: policy-edited-at-marker.md
- Migration folder layout and apply command: code-migrations.md
- Release checks and per-migration undo note: policy-release-checklist.md
- Error body shape: policy-error-response.md. Conflict: code-error-shape.md shows a different 401 body. For new errors I followed policy-error-response.md.
- Status codes: code-error-shape.md (validation, missing token, other errors). Gap: no rule sets the status for an edit refused by the window or by a non-author. Not decided here.
- Token header: code-auth-header.md
- Unit tests: code-test-layout.md

## Steps
1. Migration adding editedAt. It must not change existing rows. Include the undo note.
2. Service: load comment by id, check author and window, update body and editedAt.
3. Route: PUT handler. Errors use the rule shape.
4. Unit tests in the services folder, with the mocked database.

content.text: I'll check for any leftover 15-minute references and em dashes in the files I touched.

The comment edit window is now 30 minutes after creation, matching the team's edit-window note. The code had 15.

**Rule checked:** A comment author may edit their own comment for 30 minutes after the comment was created. After that the API refuses the edit.
- **Value used:** 30 minutes.
- **Source:** `policy-edit-window.md`. The spec `specs/feature-1-comment-editing.md` names the same note, and no other source sets a window.

**Changes made:**
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`: `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS` changed from `15 * 60 * 1000` to `30 * 60 * 1000`.
- `app/src/tests/services/article.service.test.ts`: the boundary test now uses exactly 30 minutes (allowed) and 30 minutes plus 1 ms (refused). Both test names were updated to match.

I searched `app/src` afterwards and found no remaining 15-minute references.

**Other rules checked, no change needed:**
- Edited marker: `policy-edited-at-marker.md`. `editedAt` is a nullable `DateTime?` in `schema.prisma`. The migration only adds the column, so existing rows are unchanged.
- Migration undo note: `policy-release-checklist.md`. The migration has a one-line `-- Undo:` note.
- Migration folder name and layout: `code-migrations.md`. The folder is `20261030120000_comment_edited_at`.
- Ownership: `code-comment-ownership.md`. The lookup filters on `authorId`.
- Error body: `policy-error-response.md`. New errors use `{"errors":{...}}`.
- Test location: `code-test-layout.md`. The tests are in `app/src/tests/services` and use the mocked database.

**Open gap, not changed:** No rule sets the HTTP status for an edit that is refused by the window or by a non-author. The code uses 500 for both, taken from the catch-all in `code-error-shape.md`. The team needs to decide this. I did not invent a status.

**Not verified:** I could not run the migration, `npx prisma migrate deploy`, or the Jest tests in this session. The tests were checked by reading only.
